notes.title: Update: Ver. 1.0.4 now available
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33443774/56baf2264f59cfc811f9e07f4cbb3521f3e9eacd.jpg[/img]

Ver. 1.0.4:

- Tutorial added
- Saturn added
- Saturn Ring elements contain 0 to 174 million stones
- Saturn ring names and more comparisons
- Saturn Scene with UFO flight mode
- Mars (old water level adjustable)
- Mars geology (detailed legend)
- Horizontal alignment in the 3D detail view (Rk)
- Softer camera movements
- New 360 ° ship camera
- New light direction function (sun follows position for max details)
- Improved performance
- New start options
- Vsync selectable
- Moon or Mars scene start option with flight mode
- Object selection bug fixed
- Scene double loaded error eliminated
- Spaceshuttle Cockpit Display indicates distance to Moon Ground
- Various improvements

notes.title: New Update: Ver. 1.0.2
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.2:

- Huge Quality improvement (200% better quality of the moon surface)
- Added direct x 9 support (black moon fix)
- Added pause when entering esc menue
- Increased range of the ship sensor
- Enemies improved
- Reduced installation size from 15,4 GB to 14,9 GB
- several small fixes

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33443774/74690c52c123aa4007f2dd2711da0260db3596cc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Update to ver. 1.0.1
notes.content:
Ver. 1.0.1:

- Added German language support
- Added Spanish language support
- Added Sounds (Background & FX)
- Added more Ground Enemys
- Added target menu
- Joystick Controller Support
- Better performance 
- 2GB less installation size on HDD
- Added shields to your ship
- Added repair function (ship will burn at 32 hp and must be repaired)
- Fixed earth side button issue when using moon rotation 
- Added function to start the game with less than 8GB RAM
